ports.definition: 128x128 tile输入接收端累计；同一个源向量进入不同tile或不同逻辑求值调用均另计。
ports.aggregation: Sum distinct receiver events; ratio from total Q_S / total Q_R.

operator.definition: 整矩阵阶段入口；同阶段同一输入身份向并行分支分发只计一次；串行新阶段输入再次计。
operator.not_external_io_of_entire_ffn: FFN down的中间输入仍计数；不是只统计整个FFN外部的x。
operator.standalone_component_values: 分项operator值是各矩阵独立入口；聚合QKV或gate/up必须扣除共享输入重叠，不能直接相加。

precision.reference_format: signed INT8 logical matrix operands; one Byte per element

roles.b_p: softmax后重定标的Attention系数（非负INT8子域）
roles.b_W: 一般resident权重；QKV预驻留窗口不收费
roles.b_K/b_V: resident K/V（方向分别为序列行/序列列）

precision.scales: 数字接口预置各层/头/角色的定标参数，窗口内固定；不把定标元数据算作矩阵数值payload。
precision.handoff: tile输出在数字域按输入分块累加为足够宽的部分和，再执行适用的norm/RoPE/softmax/SiLU/乘法/值缩放，按下一阶段角色重定标成INT8。
payload_excludes: internal bit planes / ADC conversions / encoding / verify / restore
precision.throughput_note: 数字衔接与尾块仍需实际实现时间/资源，不因排除于payload而无代价。

mapping.W_orientation: N output rows, K input columns
mapping.policy: weight-stationary / resident-state-stationary within the declared residency
mapping.semantic_banks: Q, optional attention-output G, K, V; FFN gate, up, down; each has independent row/column tile grids. No tile straddles two semantic matrices.
mapping.fusion_rule: checkpoint fused tensors are logically sliced/reordered without duplicating weights; source fusion does not merge CIM receiver ports.
mapping.same_source_sharing: input buffer shared upstream; operator frontier counts it once, each receiving tile bank counts its own valid input slice.
mapping.tile_order: each matrix uses output blocks then input blocks; calls are logical service events, not an optimized clock schedule.
mapping.load_order: dynamic residency: write each active resident tile once before first use; retain all tiles through declared uses; static weights loaded before window.
mapping.capacity: enough logical service units for all declared resident tiles including final L; no capacity-induced reloads or cross-bank reuse of one physical tile assumed.
mapping.partial_sums: sum input-block contributions in digital accumulator outside CIM input ports; no partial-sum reinjection as extra matvec input.
mapping.tail: count only actual valid n_i x k_j resident elements and k_j streaming inputs; preserve tile shape/call count; no proportional-time inference.
mapping.append: fixed absolute-token tile coordinates; K adds row slices 1 x k_j; V adds column slices n_i x 1. No shifting, compaction or whole-tile rewrite.
mapping.gqa: one K/V state per KV head; sequentially service its query-head group, not persistent repeat_kv copies.

symbols.F: dense FFN or single routed expert width
symbols.B: input vectors served during one FFN/expert residency
symbols.A: complete matrix loads in generic template
symbols.D_g: additional attention-output gate width, 0 when absent; H_q*d_V for selected Qwen layers
symbols.T_N/T_K: 128 for reference; arbitrary positive integers in synthetic checks

helpers.S_T(L): T*m*(m+1)/2 + (m+1)*r, m=floor(L/T), r=L-m*T; equals sum_{i=1}^L ceil(i/T)

matrix.RI: Q_S/Q_R when Q_R>0; infinity if Q_R=0 and Q_S>0; empty window undefined

FFN.window: one load then B uses; one dense FFN or one routed expert only
FFN.aggregate_operator_Q_S: B*(D*b_x+F*b_z); subtract B*D*b_x shared gate/up input
FFN.RI: aggregate Q_S / aggregate Q_R; component RI computed individually, never averaged

Attention_prefix_i.query_vectors: H_q distinct queries per token; no cross-head input deduplication

Attention_prefill.window: start empty segment KV; for i=1..L append token i once, evaluate all H_q causal queries at prefix i, then continue

Attention_decode.window: start with L-1 resident tokens; append one; evaluate H_q queries with visible length L
Attention_decode.telescoping: prefill(L)-prefill(L-1)=decode(L) separately for Q_S,Q_R and calls under this same prefix policy; do not subtract RIs

attention_handoff: K after required norm/RoPE, V after applicable value scaling, then quantize/write once. Scores are wide digital outputs; softmax coefficients are re-quantized and received only at AV input. Attention rows exclude projection/O-projection weights.
append_hardware_limit: Logical append shape is preserved; no blanket full-tile rewriting or assumption all Task-I media realize the same update efficiency. Future physical feasibility requires compatible write modes and aggregation.

sources.use: native matrices and pinned implementation anchors; not batch evaluated

python_api.outputs: All Q values are exact Fractions in Python. JSON rationals use numerator/denominator; infinity is a string.
